name: profile-settings
title: Profile settings card
description: Account profile card: first, middle and last name plus the display name, with a host-owned save port. Data loading, persistence and toasts stay in the host.
postInstall: Render <ProfileSettings labels={...} profile={...} onSave={...} /> inside your settings shell. The host supplies translated labels, the current account values and a save function that persists them and toasts. Requires the shadcn ui primitives button, card, input and label.
